old: Red wine and blood orange sangria

dish.n: Blood orange and red grape cooler
dish.note: Red grape and blood orange juice with black tea and honey over sliced fruit.
dish.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and cool. This gives a dry, grippy finish. Stir the grape juice with the tea, blood orange juice, vanilla and honey until the honey dissolves. Add the sliced orange, diced apple and cinnamon stick. Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each, and top with a splash of soda water.
